positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a cross functional team of developers to implement vector search into Scribd's search algorithm.
Contributed to a company wide effort to split the Scribd product into two separate brands, Scribd focusing on user generated content, and Everand focusing on premium content provided by publishers.
Cooperated with project managers, designers, and cross functional teams to implement new features and improvements to the search experience.
Created, reviewed, and implemented REST API design specifications.
Reviewed, provided feedback, and approved pull requests by other developers.
Implemented A/B tests for new features to determine the best functionality to optimize user engagement.
Collaborated with Machine Learning Engineers to provide users with more relevant recommendations while optimizing costs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Independently developed,  implemented, and tested complex front-end and back-end features in an existing code base.
Collaborated with fellow engineers and project managers to plan for future features in an existing product.
Worked with fellow engineers and architects to design data models and code structures for new features.
Designed REST APIs with fellow engineers to support custom logic implemented on top of the company's product.
Reviewed complex code changes implemented by fellow engineers and provided guidance to junior engineers.
Collaborated in meetings for each stage of the Software Development Lifecycle.
Communicated product changes to Technical Writers to help them document the new product features and changes for customers.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented features and bug fixes on both the front end and back end of the product.
Collaborated with Project Managers and other Engineers to plan epics for future releases.
Worked with Senior Engineers and architects to design data models and code structures for new features.
Documented additions and modifications to the product's API.
Communicated product changes to Technical Writers to help them document the new product features and changes for customers.
Reviewed code changes developed by other Engineers and recommended improvements to those changes.
Collaborated in meetings for each stage of the Software Development Lifecycle.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed minor features and fixes for minor bugs in both the front end and back end of the product.
Estimated complexity of tasks to be worked on in the future by engineers on the team.
Collaborated with senior engineers on complex tasks such as refactoring large features to gain a deeper understanding of the code base.
Participated in meetings for various stages of the Software Development Lifecycle.
